title: The palette shows a menu you can filter and move through
body:
The palette is drawn as a box on the overlay layer, and every key is swallowed while it is open (see the milestone).

## Proposal

- A list view that draws one menu level: a query line on top, then rows of icon, label and dim description. The selected row takes the accent colour.
- The query line takes typed text, with Backspace and a cursor. Typing filters the rows of the current level by label and description.
- Up and Down, or Ctrl+J and Ctrl+K, move the selection. Enter runs a row or opens its submenu. Esc goes up a level, and closes the palette at the root.
- The root holds Launch, Layout and Settings as submenus. Each is filled by its own issue.
